leadText: Magical Pokémon Journey: Kadabra's Magic Show is the twelfth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the 7th and 8th bonus chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of . As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
plainText:
Magical Pokémon Journey: Kadabra's Magic Show is the twelfth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the 7th and 8th bonus chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of . As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
 
==Blurb==
PSYCHIC POKéMON APLENTY!

Hazel loses her pictures of Almond, and Kadabra arrives to help her and the Pokémon look for them psychically! 

Then, while Hazel is gathering vegetables to make curry, Psyduck pops--up when Psyduck gets a headache, weird things happen.....

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
The Heart's Search
Why, Psyduck, Why?

==Important events==
Hazel's Pokémon meet Kadabra and find her missing photo.
